1.desc:
A soft blue toile stream, hand drawn hills and one of the most loved lines in all of Scripture. This is the blanket for the day that has been far too loud.

"He leads me beside quiet waters." Psalm 23:2

Hello, I am Nthabiseng, the heart behind Little Hearts, Mighty God. I am a single mom, so I know what it is to need a promise you can physically hold on to at the end of a long day. That is why I make these. This is a real woven blanket, with the design woven into the cotton threads themselves, not printed on top, so it will not crack, peel or fade away in the wash.

MAKE IT PERSONAL
Use the personalization box to add a name, a family name, a special date or your own favorite short verse, up to 70 characters. I place your words into the design by hand before it is made, so it suits the artwork and reads beautifully. Prefer it exactly as pictured? Simply leave the box blank and I will send the design as shown.

Ideas that work well: The Johnson Family. Grace, Baptized May 2026. In Loving Memory Of Grandma Rose. Jeremiah 29:11.

WHO IT IS FOR
Single moms and single dads who are carrying a lot and could use something soft to carry them. Anyone healing from grief, illness, heartbreak or a hard year. Newlyweds, new parents, graduates, pastors, grandparents and the friend you keep meaning to do something kind for. Scripture speaks to all of us, so this blanket does too.

THE DETAILS
100% cotton, thick woven jacquard
Soft fringe on all four sides
The back shows the design in reversed colors, which is rather lovely
Three sizes: 37 x 52 in for laps and little ones, 50 x 60 in classic throw, 60 x 80 in bed size
Made to order in the USA
Scripture quoted from the Berean Standard Bible

CARE
Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle and tumble dry low. No bleach, no ironing, no fuss. I have a child, I do not make things that cannot survive a washing machine.

SHIPPING AND TIMING
Each blanket is woven just for you, so please allow about 5 business days to make it plus shipping time. Ordering for Christmas? Earlier is kinder to both of us.

A NOTE ON COLOR
Woven yarn is softer and more textured than a screen, so colors look slightly more muted in person and fine details have a gentle, stitched look. That is the charm of a true woven piece.

MY PROMISE AND POLICY
Every blanket is woven just for you, so I cannot accept returns or exchanges for change of mind, sizing or colour preference. Please check your spelling in the personalisation box, as I weave exactly what you type. If your order arrives damaged, faulty or wrong, message me within 14 days of delivery with photos and I will send you a free replacement. Cancellations are accepted within 24 hours of purchase, before production begins.

Thank you for supporting a small, prayed over shop. May this blanket remind you every day that you are held.

With love,
Nthabiseng
Little Hearts, Mighty God

Delicate grapevines in soft green around the invitation to stay close. Quietly elegant, and very at home on a reading chair or a prayer corner.

"Remain in Me, and I will remain in you." John 15:4

Hello, I am Nthabiseng, the heart behind Little Hearts, Mighty God. I am a single mom, so I know what it is to need a promise you can physically hold on to at the end of a long day. That is why I make these. This is a real woven blanket, with the design woven into the cotton threads themselves, not printed on top, so it will not crack, peel or fade away in the wash.

MAKE IT PERSONAL
Use the personalization box to add a name, a family name, a special date or your own favorite short verse, up to 70 characters. I place your words into the design by hand before it is made, so it suits the artwork and reads beautifully. Prefer it exactly as pictured? Simply leave the box blank and I will send the design as shown.

Ideas that work well: The Johnson Family. Grace, Baptized May 2026. In Loving Memory Of Grandma Rose. Jeremiah 29:11.

WHO IT IS FOR
Single moms and single dads who are carrying a lot and could use something soft to carry them. Anyone healing from grief, illness, heartbreak or a hard year. Newlyweds, new parents, graduates, pastors, grandparents and the friend you keep meaning to do something kind for. Scripture speaks to all of us, so this blanket does too.

THE DETAILS
100% cotton, thick woven jacquard
Soft fringe on all four sides
The back shows the design in reversed colors, which is rather lovely
Three sizes: 37 x 52 in for laps and little ones, 50 x 60 in classic throw, 60 x 80 in bed size
Made to order in the USA
Scripture quoted from the Berean Standard Bible

CARE
Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle and tumble dry low. No bleach, no ironing, no fuss. I have a child, I do not make things that cannot survive a washing machine.

SHIPPING AND TIMING
Each blanket is woven just for you, so please allow about 5 business days to make it plus shipping time. Ordering for Christmas? Earlier is kinder to both of us.

A NOTE ON COLOR
Woven yarn is softer and more textured than a screen, so colors look slightly more muted in person and fine details have a gentle, stitched look. That is the charm of a true woven piece.

If your order arrives damaged, faulty or wrong, message me within 14 days of delivery with photos and I will send you a free replacement. A blue arched frame around rolling hills, and an open invitation to look at what God has done. Made for the family with a testimony to tell.

"Come and see the works of God." Psalm 66:5

Hello, I am Nthabiseng, the heart behind Little Hearts, Mighty God. I am a single mom, so I know what it is to need a promise you can physically hold on to at the end of a long day. That is why I make these. This is a real woven blanket, with the design woven into the cotton threads themselves, not printed on top, so it will not crack, peel or fade away in the wash.

MAKE IT PERSONAL
Use the personalization box to add a name, a family name, a special date or your own favorite short verse, up to 70 characters. I place your words into the design by hand before it is made, so it suits the artwork and reads beautifully. Prefer it exactly as pictured? Simply leave the box blank and I will send the design as shown.

Ideas that work well: The Johnson Family. Grace, Baptized May 2026. In Loving Memory Of Grandma Rose. Jeremiah 29:11.

WHO IT IS FOR
Single moms and single dads who are carrying a lot and could use something soft to carry them. Anyone healing from grief, illness, heartbreak or a hard year. Newlyweds, new parents, graduates, pastors, grandparents and the friend you keep meaning to do something kind for. Scripture speaks to all of us, so this blanket does too.

THE DETAILS
100% cotton, thick woven jacquard
Soft fringe on all four sides
The back shows the design in reversed colors, which is rather lovely
Three sizes: 37 x 52 in for laps and little ones, 50 x 60 in classic throw, 60 x 80 in bed size
Made to order in the USA
Scripture quoted from the Berean Standard Bible

CARE
Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle and tumble dry low. No bleach, no ironing, no fuss. I have a child, I do not make things that cannot survive a washing machine.

SHIPPING AND TIMING
Each blanket is woven just for you, so please allow about 5 business days to make it plus shipping time. Ordering for Christmas? Earlier is kinder to both of us.

A NOTE ON COLOR
Woven yarn is softer and more textured than a screen, so colors look slightly more muted in person and fine details have a gentle, stitched look. That is the charm of a true woven piece.

MY PROMISE AND POLICY
Every blanket is woven just for you, so I cannot accept returns or exchanges for change of mind, sizing or colour preference. Please check your spelling in the personalisation box, as I weave exactly what you type. If your order arrives damaged, faulty or wrong, message me within 14 days of delivery with photos and I will send you a free replacement. Cancellations are accepted within 24 hours of purchase, before production begins.

Thank you for supporting a small, prayed over shop. May this blanket remind you every day that you are held.

With love,
Nthabiseng
Little Hearts, Mighty God

28.desc:
Blush magnolia branches with petals drifting down, and a reminder that He is the God of all comfort. Send it to the friend in recovery, in grief, or just in the thick of it.

"The God of all comfort." 2 Corinthians 1:3

Hello, I am Nthabiseng, the heart behind Little Hearts, Mighty God. I am a single mom, so I know what it is to need a promise you can physically hold on to at the end of a long day. That is why I make these. This is a real woven blanket, with the design woven into the cotton threads themselves, not printed on top, so it will not crack, peel or fade away in the wash.

MAKE IT PERSONAL
Use the personalization box to add a name, a family name, a special date or your own favorite short verse, up to 70 characters. I place your words into the design by hand before it is made, so it suits the artwork and reads beautifully. Prefer it exactly as pictured? Simply leave the box blank and I will send the design as shown.

Ideas that work well: The Johnson Family. Grace, Baptized May 2026. In Loving Memory Of Grandma Rose. Jeremiah 29:11.

WHO IT IS FOR
Single moms and single dads who are carrying a lot and could use something soft to carry them. Anyone healing from grief, illness, heartbreak or a hard year. Newlyweds, new parents, graduates, pastors, grandparents and the friend you keep meaning to do something kind for. Scripture speaks to all of us, so this blanket does too.

THE DETAILS
100% cotton, thick woven jacquard
Soft fringe on all four sides
The back shows the design in reversed colors, which is rather lovely
Three sizes: 37 x 52 in for laps and little ones, 50 x 60 in classic throw, 60 x 80 in bed size
Made to order in the USA
Scripture quoted from the Berean Standard Bible

CARE
Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle and tumble dry low. No bleach, no ironing, no fuss. I have a child, I do not make things that cannot survive a washing machine.

SHIPPING AND TIMING
Each blanket is woven just for you, so please allow about 5 business days to make it plus shipping time. Ordering for Christmas? Earlier is kinder to both of us.

A NOTE ON COLOR
Woven yarn is softer and more textured than a screen, so colors look slightly more muted in person and fine details have a gentle, stitched look. That is the charm of a true woven piece.

MY PROMISE AND POLICY
Every blanket is woven just for you, so I cannot accept returns or exchanges for change of mind, sizing or colour preference. Please check your spelling in the personalisation box, as I weave exactly what you type. If your order arrives damaged, faulty or wrong, message me within 14 days of delivery with photos and I will send you a free replacement. Cancellations are accepted within 24 hours of purchase, before production begins.

Thank you for supporting a small, prayed over shop. May this blanket remind you every day that you are held.

With love,
Nthabiseng
Little Hearts, Mighty God
